blocks.text: MADRID, Spain — At a protest in Madrid, Hugo, 22, recalled an attack that he believes illustrates the problems that will push him to vote for the far right in Sunday’s Spanish general election. The student, who refused to give his surname, said he was outside a hospital in the Madrid suburb of Leganes, where his mother was being treated, when he was mugged at gunpoint by four assailants he believed were Latin Americans “in an irregular situation”.
